name.en: A resume from the public anamnesis

description.en: Writes a one-page resume (Markdown) from the records of the anamnesis that the owner confirmed and marked public: who they are, skills with their levels, projects, milestones, tools. Nothing private or sensitive is read; no link or address the facts do not have gets in. Saves a file in the project; nothing is sent.
description.ru: Пишет резюме на одну страницу (Markdown) из записей анамнеза, которые владелец подтвердил и пометил публичными: кто он, навыки с уровнями, проекты, вехи, инструменты. Приватное и чувствительное не читается, ссылки и адреса, которых нет в фактах, не попадают. Сохраняет файл в проекте, ничего не отправляет.

ru: Составь моё резюме из публичных записей анамнеза
Сделай резюме-портфолио по тому, что я пометил публичным
Нужно резюме под вакансию маркетолога, бери только публичное из анамнеза
Подготовь портфолио обо мне из анамнеза
en: Write my resume from the public records of my anamnesis
Make a one-page portfolio from what I marked public

notes.note: the role or vacancy to aim at, what to stress; never a source of facts

quality_mode.effect: not used: there are no code tasks

machines: the owner's Mac mini: the anamnesis store (~/.lane-pilot/anamnesis) is read through the host

nodes.rule: code: the owner's records that are confirmed AND marked public, nothing else; drafts, candidates, private and sensitive records never leave the Mac mini

nodes.prompt: Write the owner's resume as ONE Markdown document of at most one page: name or role line, a summary of two or three sentences, skills with the level the facts give, projects with what they are, milestones in date order, tools. Aim it at what `notes` says, but only choose and order facts, never add one. Sources: ONLY `facts_text`: records the owner confirmed and marked public. Nothing else is a source: not your memory of the owner, not this chat, not `notes` (`notes` only says what to stress). Do not invent employers, dates, numbers, places, links or e-mail addresses; every link or address you write must stand in the facts. A part with no facts is left out, not filled. Language: `language` (ru or en). If `fix` is given, a check of your earlier text failed: correct exactly those violations. Put the whole text in `artifact`.

title.en: Check what was written against the facts

nodes.rule: code: not empty, within the size limit, no link or e-mail address that the facts do not contain, no draft mark

map.reason: 'no record is both confirmed and marked public: open the Anamnesis tab, confirm what is right and mark what may be shown as public'
'the text did not pass the check against the public facts twice (a link, address or mark that is not in the facts)'
